description: Need plugin-managed BSON type registration to replace hardcoded BsonType.Vector enum value and BsonValue.AsVector helpers in the core.
proposedSolution: Introduce a plugin-managed BSON type registration with reserved type codes that lets LiteDB.Vector supply serializers and deserializers without edits to BsonType or BsonValue.
backwardCompatibility: Preserve reading of existing databases by keeping legacy Vector type aliases and providing upgrade shims that delegate to the plugin registry when available.
